title: Apply at the announced time and report
goal: At the time, the update runs through the safe lifecycle path and the result is reported
acceptance: Uses the existing automatic policy and lifecycle update; reports applied, refused (with reason and next try) or failed (with recovery)
Restart and after-start health check in the report
privacy: Local only; tests use invented bases, revisions and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 at agent speed (harness 8.14.3: implementation steps 0.75 h, small fixes 0.5 h). Not a measurement.
